title: Range of the Reciprocal Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: On its natural domain, describe the range of f(x)=1/x.

steps.title: Observe Zero Is Impossible
steps.explanation: No matter how large |x| gets, 1/x stays a nonzero fraction; it merely approaches 0.
steps.why: A fraction 1/x equals zero only if 1=0, which never happens.

steps.title: Show Every Nonzero Value Is Hit
steps.explanation: Given any y != 0, the input x=1/y is legal and satisfies 1/x = y.
steps.why: The reciprocal map is its own inverse, so it reaches every nonzero target.

steps.title: State the Range
steps.explanation: The function takes all positive and all negative values but never zero.
steps.why: Removing the single unattainable output 0 splits the line into two open rays.
